summary: Compose the corrected model scan or Padé diagnostic and save scientific terminal arrays, complete carriers when needed, and labelled plots.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: Four legacy scientific purposes es1d/es3d/em/generator retained. Source D1 plots remain historical evidence, not a known-wrong corrected default. Rounded raster plots are distinct from decimal carrier state; human visual approval remains explicit.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Scientific purpose: es1d, es3d, em or generator.
inputs.constraints: Explicit model selection; no implicit conversion between ES and EM deck conventions.

inputs.name: output_dir
inputs.description: Fresh caller-owned directory for scientific arrays, complete carrier metadata where applicable, and labelled PNG.
inputs.constraints: Directory must not already exist; filesystem/presentation failure propagates. Human visual approval remains pending.

inputs.name: points
inputs.description: Finite ordered wavevector tuples. None uses exact original for-loop iterates: ES1D .4:-.02:.01; ES3D kx .05:.1:5,kz0; EM kc/omega_pi .01:.02:1 at71degrees.
inputs.units: ES wavevectors dimensionless; supplied EM kx,kz in m^-1. EM default scan parameter kc/omega_pi dimensionless.
inputs.shape: P tuples of length1 for es1d; length2 for es3d/em
inputs.dtype: iterable of real tuples or None
inputs.constraints: ES1D k!=0; ES3D kx²+kz²>0; EM uniform kx=kz=0 supported. Input order and all per-point carrier records preserved; no padding of differing mode counts.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.description: Species table; None reads the packaged default for the selected model. ES1D columns q,m,n,T,vd. ES3D q,m,n,Tparallel,Tperp,vd. EM q/e,m/me,n,Tparallel,Tperp,vd/c.
inputs.units: ES dimensionless normalized quantities; EM n in m^-3, T in eV, mass in electron masses.
inputs.shape: Sx5 for es1d; Sx6 for es3d/em
inputs.constraints: Nonzero charge; positive mass,density,temperatures; EM S>=2 for declared second-species normalizers. Finite after float64 narrowing. Applies only to es1d/es3d/em scan branch; omit for generator.

inputs.name: J
inputs.description: Model-dependent pole order when omitted: scan models8, generator12. This metadata maps branch defaults; it is not a dictionary passed as J.
inputs.constraints: For scan models use the supported fixed-table orders; for generator integerJ>=1 and0<=I<=2J. Omit unsupported branch controls.

inputs.name: opt
inputs.description: ES1D table variant; None selects J4 variant2, otherwise variant1.
inputs.constraints: ES1D opt1 or2. Only J4/J8 distinguish variants; other model tables do not use opt. Applies only to es1d/es3d/em scan branch; omit for generator.

inputs.name: N
inputs.description: Retained cyclotron harmonic index n=-N,...,N. None selects ES3D10 or EM2; ES1D does not use N.
inputs.constraints: Integer>=0 when relevant. Uniform EM k0 uses analytic gyro response independently of this cutoff, including N0. Applies only to es1d/es3d/em scan branch; omit for generator.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Signed background field along z; None selects ES3D1 or EM100e-9. ES1D has no field.
inputs.constraints: Relevant magnetized field finite and nonzero; no inferred unmagnetized substitute. ES3D Omega_s=B0*q_s/m_s. Applies only to es1d/es3d/em scan branch; omit for generator.

inputs.name: sp
inputs.description: Dense0 or shifted sparse1 for ES1D/EM; ES3D uses its qualified descriptor/interlacing path.
inputs.constraints: sp0 or1. Sparse frequency count follows solve_matrix default1; original shifted solve limitations still apply. Applies only to es1d/es3d/em scan branch; omit for generator.

inputs.name: wg0
inputs.description: Initial EM frequency guess normalized by source wci=abs(Omega_second). Internal physical shift begins wg0*wci and updates from the preceding selected root. ES ignores this control.
inputs.constraints: Finite after complex128 narrowing. Ordered continuation state is owned by this call. Applies only to es1d/es3d/em scan branch; omit for generator.

inputs.name: I
inputs.description: Number of Taylor matching equations; K=2J-I inverse-power equations. Generator branch only; omit for scan models.
inputs.constraints: Integer0<=I<=2J. Meaningful accuracy must be independently checked for selected J/I and z domain.

inputs.name: precision
inputs.description: Decimal coefficient/root construction precision; numeric result ports remain complex128. Generator branch only; omit for scan models.
inputs.constraints: Integer>=32; repeated/unresolved roots fail explicitly. Higher precision alone does not certify finite-J approximation accuracy.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

outputs.name: artifacts
outputs.description: Scientific arrays/plot metadata/hash inventory, human approval pending.
outputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

outputs.name: output_dir
outputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
supported: Fresh caller-owned output directory and constituent scientific preconditions.
excluded: Historical PNG identity is not claimed after scientific correction.
No rendering success implies human scientific endorsement.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Model and branch-specific constituent argument failures propagate; omit controls unsupported by the selected branch.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Constituent native/Python errors propagate; fresh output-directory creation, Matplotlib and filesystem failures propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Selected scan or Padé/evaluation qualification failures stop before successful presentation.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Presentation may leave a partial fresh output directory if writing fails; no successful composition is returned. Numeric completion is separate from human visual approval.

example.description: Corrected two-point perpendicular ES3D presentation in a fresh output directory.
example.code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.workflows import reassemble_rational_program
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    r = reassemble_rational_program({'model': 'es3d', 'output_dir': str(Path(td)/'program'), 'J': 4, 'N': 1, 'points': [(0.2, 0.0), (0.3, 0.0)]})
    assert len(r['result']['spectra']) == 2
example.expected: Corrected numerical terminal, complete frequency carriers and labelled plot with explicit unit/rounded-view metadata; historical PNG identity and human approval not claimed.
